name: Swiper
description: Swipe-to-open wrapper that reveals a drawer or sheet panel.

fields.expands: bool? - panel fills its slide axis (drawer: false, sheet: true)
fields.draggable: bool? - the open panel can be dragged away
fields.barrierDismissible: bool? - barrier tap dismisses the panel
fields.useSafeArea: bool? - panel respects the device safe area
fields.showDragHandle: bool? - draw the panel drag handle; null keeps DrawerTheme
fields.borderRadius: BorderRadius? - panel inner-corner radius; null keeps DrawerTheme
fields.maxSize: double? - panel extent along its slide axis; null keeps DrawerTheme
fields.barrierColor: ThemedColor? - barrier colour; null is black at 50%
fields.behavior: HitTestBehavior? - hit test behaviour of the swipe gesture
fields.threshold: double? - fraction (0..1) of the panel a release must pass to open
